summary: Calisa Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing a prepaid forward purchase agreement with Harraden Circle Investments for up to 3,000,000 ordinary shares at no more than the redemption price, with trust cash at roughly $10.31 per public share as of August 31, 2026. The arrangement supports its pending March 6, 2026 business combination with Goodvision AI Inc., whereby Calisa Merger Sub will merge into Goodvision. Purchaser votes no shares; prepayment emerges from trust disbursements. Approach: monitor redemptions, trust retention, and deal-close mechanics.
